title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the differential cross section, d sigma/d Omega, as (m a / (2 pi hbar^2))^2.

title: Scattering Amplitude
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the scattering amplitude f(theta) correctly from the potential using the Fourier transform.

title: Low Momentum Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must state the condition for low momentum, ks << 1, for the approximation to hold.

title: Transition Rate
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Fermi's golden rule to find the transition rate w in terms of the potential and density of states.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect signs in the scattering amplitude or neglecting the normalization of the potential.
